title: Cost integral with tiered pricing and a constraint on average rate
text: A machine runs for 7 hours with power consumption P(t) = 9.95 + 3.71t kW. Electricity price is 0.131 per kWh up to 105.79 kWh total usage, then 0.317 beyond, and if usage during any single hour exceeds 26.79, an extra surcharge 0.157 per kWh applies to that hour only. Tiered pricing applies to total kWh over the full run; the hourly surcharge adds to the base price for all kWh consumed during that hour. Compute total cost and the average price per kWh.

title: Differential equation with intervention at threshold and total-dose constraint
